name: An experiment
description: one experiment folder in one wetlab repository: its name, where it is, what it is about, and the lists of oligos, plasmids, samples, construction files, sequences, reads and data files it used or made
phrases: the shape of an experiment record
which oligos and plasmids an experiment used

path.description: repo-relative folder. An experiment lives in exactly one repository

description.description: what it is about, when a README or notebook says

description_from.description: the file the description was read from

oligos.description: oligo names it used. A common oligo appears in many experiments' lists and belongs to none

plasmids.description: plasmid and construct names it used. A common vector appears in many lists, likewise

samples.description: the samples it produced (sample.schema), named by construct and clone, or the files that hold them

notes:
Every list holds references: bare means the record of that name in this repository, `<world>:<name>` one in another (C11 sharables 3.9.4).

NO `project` FIELD, on JCA's correction 2026-10-22: membership is the project's list (project.schema), because an experiment can belong to several projects or to none.

A COPY IS NOT A SECOND EXPERIMENT. An experiment copied unchanged into another repository (old data placed in a students' repository) is the same entry, and the earliest committed is canonical (C11 sharables 3.9.5). Edited, it is a different experiment (3.9.6).

Generalises Pimar's pimar.experiment, which has the same fields less plasmids, samples and data_files, and requires its four lists. Here only name and path are required, because a repository that records no reads has not recorded an empty list of them.

ITS INSTANCES LIVE OUTSIDE THE STORE, ON PURPOSE: an experiment is a folder in the wetlab repository that owns it — UCB_iGEM_Cheese/Experiments/<name>, UCB_iGEM_Assembly/experiments/<name>, Pimar/experiments/<name>, UCB_iGEM_SynThera/SLIP<n> at the root — and is read where it lives (Cortex's `labindex` indexes those folders without copying them). Pimar's 59 records conform to its own narrower pimar.experiment, not to this schema; no record has been written against this one yet (2026-10-28). Said here because Cortex's tests/test_schema_orphans.py asks every schema with no dependents to say why.
